title: Lakehouse · Tables
description: Every dataset's Delta tables on RustFS (bronze, silver, history, quarantine, gold, reference), discovered from the lake and read straight from their transaction logs through ClickHouse: versions, commits, live files, rows, file sizes, partitions and the commit log.

list.name: dataset
list.label: Dataset
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT splitByChar('/', replaceRegexpOne(_path, '^[^/]+/(.+)/_delta_log/.*$', '\\1'))[2] AS dataset
FROM s3(lake, filename = '**/_delta_log/00000000000000000000.json', format = 'JSONAsString')
WHERE splitByChar('/', replaceRegexpOne(_path, '^[^/]+/(.+)/_delta_log/.*$', '\\1'))[1] IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'history', 'quarantine', 'gold', 'reference')
ORDER BY dataset

panels.title: Live rows
panels.description: Rows in the current snapshot of the selected datasets' tables, per layer: bronze (as ingested, every chunk), silver (cleaned, every chunk), history (every version of every fact, SCD2), gold (aggregates).

targets.rawSql:
WITH log AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT replaceRegexpOne(_path, '^[^/]+/(.+)/_delta_log/.*$', '\\1') AS path,
               path AS table,
               splitByChar('/', path)[1] AS layer,
               splitByChar('/', path)[2] AS dataset,
               toUInt64(extract(_file, '^(\\d+)\\.json$')) AS version,
               json
        FROM s3(lake, filename = '**/_delta_log/*.json', format = 'JSONAsString')
    )
    WHERE layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'history', 'quarantine', 'gold', 'reference') AND dataset IN (${dataset:singlequote})
),
adds AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'path') AS file, JSONExtractUInt(json, 'add', 'size') AS bytes,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'add', 'partitionValues') AS part,
           JSONExtractUInt(JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'stats'), 'numRecords') AS records
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'add')
),
removes AS (
    SELECT table, file, min(version) AS removed_in
    FROM (SELECT table, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'remove', 'path') AS file FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'remove'))
    GROUP BY table, file
),
files AS (
    SELECT a.table, a.layer, a.dataset, a.version AS added_in, if(r.removed_in = 0, 18446744073709551615, r.removed_in) AS removed_in, a.bytes, a.records, a.part
    FROM adds a LEFT JOIN removes r ON r.table = a.table AND r.file = a.file
),
commits AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(JSONExtractInt(json, 'commitInfo', 'timestamp')) AS ts,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operation') AS operation,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationMetrics') AS metrics,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationParameters', 'predicate') AS predicate
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'commitInfo')
)
SELECT sumIf(records, layer = 'bronze') AS bronze, sumIf(records, layer = 'silver') AS silver,
       sumIf(records, layer = 'history') AS history, sumIf(records, layer = 'gold') AS gold
FROM files WHERE removed_in = 18446744073709551615

panels.title: Compaction debt
panels.description: Share of live data files beyond the ideal count (one per partition, or one per 128 MB if larger). Every chunk adds a file; the versioner's hourly OPTIMIZE brings this back to 0.

WITH log AS (

    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'path') AS file, JSONExtractUInt(json, 'add', 'size') AS bytes,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'add', 'partitionValues') AS part,
           JSONExtractUInt(JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'stats'), 'numRecords') AS records
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'add')

removes AS (
    SELECT table, file, min(version) AS removed_in
    FROM (SELECT table, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'remove', 'path') AS file FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'remove'))
    GROUP BY table, file
),
files AS (
    SELECT a.table, a.layer, a.dataset, a.version AS added_in, if(r.removed_in = 0, 18446744073709551615, r.removed_in) AS removed_in, a.bytes, a.records, a.part
    FROM adds a LEFT JOIN removes r ON r.table = a.table AND r.file = a.file
),
commits AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(JSONExtractInt(json, 'commitInfo', 'timestamp')) AS ts,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operation') AS operation,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationMetrics') AS metrics,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationParameters', 'predicate') AS predicate
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'commitInfo')

, debt AS (
    SELECT table, count() AS live_files, greatest(uniqExact(part), toUInt64(ceil(sum(bytes) / 134217728))) AS ideal_files

panels.title: Table health
panels.description: One row per Delta table, computed from its _delta_log on RustFS through ClickHouse's s3 table function: log version, commits, live files and bytes, rows (from file stats), average file size and the small-file share.

targets.rawSql:
WITH log AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT replaceRegexpOne(_path, '^[^/]+/(.+)/_delta_log/.*$', '\\1') AS path,
               path AS table,
               splitByChar('/', _path)[1] AS bucket,
               splitByChar('/', path)[1] AS layer,
               splitByChar('/', path)[2] AS dataset,
               toUInt64(extract(_file, '^(\\d+)\\.json$')) AS version,
               json
        FROM s3(lake, filename = '**/_delta_log/*.json', format = 'JSONAsString')
    )
    WHERE layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'history', 'quarantine', 'gold', 'reference') AND dataset IN (${dataset:singlequote})
),
adds AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'path') AS file, JSONExtractUInt(json, 'add', 'size') AS bytes,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'add', 'partitionValues') AS part,
           JSONExtractUInt(JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'stats'), 'numRecords') AS records
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'add')
),
removes AS (
    SELECT table, file, min(version) AS removed_in
    FROM (SELECT table, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'remove', 'path') AS file FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'remove'))
    GROUP BY table, file
),
files AS (
    SELECT a.table, a.layer, a.dataset, a.version AS added_in, if(r.removed_in = 0, 18446744073709551615, r.removed_in) AS removed_in, a.bytes, a.records, a.part
    FROM adds a LEFT JOIN removes r ON r.table = a.table AND r.file = a.file
),
commits AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, bucket, version,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(JSONExtractInt(json, 'commitInfo', 'timestamp')) AS ts,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operation') AS operation,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationMetrics') AS metrics,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationParameters', 'predicate') AS predicate
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'commitInfo')
)
, live AS (
    SELECT table, count() AS live_files, sum(bytes) AS live_bytes, sum(records) AS live_records,
           greatest(uniqExact(part), toUInt64(ceil(sum(bytes) / 134217728))) AS ideal_files
    FROM files WHERE removed_in = 18446744073709551615 GROUP BY table
), hist AS (
    SELECT table, any(layer) AS layer, any(dataset) AS dataset, any(bucket) AS bucket, max(version) AS version, count() AS commits, max(ts) AS last_commit FROM commits GROUP BY table
)
SELECT h.layer AS layer, h.dataset AS dataset, concat('s3a://', h.bucket, '/', h.table, '/') AS location, h.version AS version, h.commits AS commits,
       l.live_files AS live_files, l.live_bytes AS size, l.live_records AS rows, round(l.live_bytes / nullIf(l.live_files, 0)) AS avg_file,
       round(100 * greatest(0, toInt64(l.live_files) - toInt64(l.ideal_files)) / nullIf(l.live_files, 0), 1) AS compaction_debt, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(h.last_commit) AS last_commit
FROM hist h LEFT JOIN live l ON l.table = h.table
ORDER BY h.dataset, indexOf(['bronze', 'silver', 'history', 'quarantine', 'gold', 'reference'], h.layer), h.table

panels.title: Live rows by commit
panels.description: Rows in each table's snapshot after every commit. Bronze and silver grow with each run (one chunk each); history grows only with new facts or new versions of changed facts (SCD2); gold is replaced per run.

    )

    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'add')

    SELECT table, file, min(version) AS removed_in
    FROM (SELECT table, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'remove', 'path') AS file FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'remove'))
    GROUP BY table, file
),
files AS (
    SELECT a.table, a.layer, a.dataset, a.version AS added_in, if(r.removed_in = 0, 18446744073709551615, r.removed_in) AS removed_in, a.bytes, a.records, a.part
    FROM adds a LEFT JOIN removes r ON r.table = a.table AND r.file = a.file

commits AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(JSONExtractInt(json, 'commitInfo', 'timestamp')) AS ts,

           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationMetrics') AS metrics,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationParameters', 'predicate') AS predicate
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'commitInfo')

SELECT c.ts AS time, c.table AS table, sumIf(f.records, f.added_in <= c.version AND f.removed_in > c.version) AS rows
FROM commits c LEFT JOIN files f ON f.table = c.table
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ts) AND c.layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'history', 'gold')
GROUP BY c.table, c.version, c.ts ORDER BY time

panels.title: Operations
panels.description: Commit operations across the selected datasets: WRITE (chunk writes, gold and references), MERGE (history), OPTIMIZE / VACUUM (maintenance), schema evolution (ADD COLUMNS, SET TBLPROPERTIES).

targets.rawSql:
WITH log AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT replaceRegexpOne(_path, '^[^/]+/(.+)/_delta_log/.*$', '\\1') AS path,
               path AS table,
               splitByChar('/', path)[1] AS layer,
               splitByChar('/', path)[2] AS dataset,
               toUInt64(extract(_file, '^(\\d+)\\.json$')) AS version,
               json
        FROM s3(lake, filename = '**/_delta_log/*.json', format = 'JSONAsString')
    )
    WHERE layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'history', 'quarantine', 'gold', 'reference') AND dataset IN (${dataset:singlequote})
),
adds AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'path') AS file, JSONExtractUInt(json, 'add', 'size') AS bytes,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'add', 'partitionValues') AS part,
           JSONExtractUInt(JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'stats'), 'numRecords') AS records
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'add')
),
removes AS (
    SELECT table, file, min(version) AS removed_in
    FROM (SELECT table, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'remove', 'path') AS file FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'remove'))
    GROUP BY table, file
),
files AS (
    SELECT a.table, a.layer, a.dataset, a.version AS added_in, if(r.removed_in = 0, 18446744073709551615, r.removed_in) AS removed_in, a.bytes, a.records, a.part
    FROM adds a LEFT JOIN removes r ON r.table = a.table AND r.file = a.file
),
commits AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(JSONExtractInt(json, 'commitInfo', 'timestamp')) AS ts,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operation') AS operation,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationMetrics') AS metrics,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationParameters', 'predicate') AS predicate
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'commitInfo')
)
SELECT operation, count() AS commits FROM commits GROUP BY operation ORDER BY commits DESC

panels.description: The last 50 commits across the lake, newest first, straight from _delta_log: operation, rows written (numOutputRows, or inserted + updated for MERGE), files added and removed, execution time, and the predicate (replaceWhere for chunk writes, the join key for MERGE).

WITH log AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT replaceRegexpOne(_path, '^[^/]+/(.+)/_delta_log/.*$', '\\1') AS path,
               path AS table,
               splitByChar('/', path)[1] AS layer,
               splitByChar('/', path)[2] AS dataset,
               toUInt64(extract(_file, '^(\\d+)\\.json$')) AS version,
               json
        FROM s3(lake, filename = '**/_delta_log/*.json', format = 'JSONAsString')
    )
    WHERE layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'history', 'quarantine', 'gold', 'reference') AND dataset IN (${dataset:singlequote})
),
adds AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'path') AS file, JSONExtractUInt(json, 'add', 'size') AS bytes,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'add', 'partitionValues') AS part,
           JSONExtractUInt(JSONExtractString(json, 'add', 'stats'), 'numRecords') AS records
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'add')
),
removes AS (
    SELECT table, file, min(version) AS removed_in
    FROM (SELECT table, version, JSONExtractString(json, 'remove', 'path') AS file FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'remove'))
    GROUP BY table, file
),
files AS (
    SELECT a.table, a.layer, a.dataset, a.version AS added_in, if(r.removed_in = 0, 18446744073709551615, r.removed_in) AS removed_in, a.bytes, a.records, a.part
    FROM adds a LEFT JOIN removes r ON r.table = a.table AND r.file = a.file
),
commits AS (
    SELECT table, layer, dataset, version,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(JSONExtractInt(json, 'commitInfo', 'timestamp')) AS ts,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operation') AS operation,
           JSONExtractRaw(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationMetrics') AS metrics,
           JSONExtractString(json, 'commitInfo', 'operationParameters', 'predicate') AS predicate
    FROM log WHERE JSONHas(json, 'commitInfo')
)
SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS time, layer, table, version, operation,
       toUInt64OrZero(coalesce(nullIf(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'numOutputRows'), ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'numTargetRowsInserted'), ''), '0'))
         + toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'numTargetRowsUpdated')) AS rows,
       toUInt64OrZero(coalesce(nullIf(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'numFiles'), ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'numAddedFiles'), ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'numTargetFilesAdded'), ''), '0')) AS files_added,
       toUInt64OrZero(coalesce(nullIf(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'numRemovedFiles'), ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'numTargetFilesRemoved'), ''), '0')) AS files_removed,
       toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractString(metrics, 'executionTimeMs')) AS duration_ms,
       trim(BOTH '[]"' FROM replaceRegexpAll(predicate, '#\d+', '')) AS predicate
FROM commits ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
